description: PAID, from one cent in USDC by x402; the first reply is the price and nothing is charged until the AI agent signs a payment. Evidence that a recording, by ISRC, exists in the frozen ProofProfile corpus: record hash, the Bitcoin-anchored OpenTimestamps proof, the CopyrightChains block, and how to check it. If a recording the person asked about is not found and find_recording lists other versions of that title, verify those too and report what each shows, naming the version; one version is never proof of another. Returned with a capsule that verifies offline and a receipt of this call anchored in Bitcoin. For checking whether a song may be AI generated: a recording in the register existed before 2022, when its source, AcousticBrainz, closed. That is evidence of age, never of human origin.

declaredValueUsd.description: The stakes in US dollars the AI agent is acting on. They set the price band (one cent under $100, ten cents from $100, one dollar from $10,000); undeclared stakes are priced at one cent. The declared figure is part of the call that the receipt anchors in Bitcoin, so the receipt shows it. No money other than the price moves.

isrcs.description: Several ISRCs in one call, in place of isrc: one payment, one receipt. Up to 50, each ISRC once: a repeated ISRC refuses the call. A wallet's first paid call holds up to 10, one call at a time; after one settled call, the full batch and up to 4 calls at once.

purpose.description: Optional: what the AI agent is about to do, in its own words. Bound into the anchored receipt as part of the call, so the receipt shows why it was made.

reference.description: Optional: the AI agent's own reference for the action, such as an order id or sha256:<hash> of its document. Bound into the anchored receipt as part of the call.
